title: Daily sales report

noodle.formula: Tickets − (noodles out − staff meals − waste) = difference
noodle.notClosed: The end count in Stock & deliveries is not entered yet. When it is, the noodle check appears automatically.

staff.help: Filled in from the shift table. Fix late arrival, leaving early, overtime or absence.

book.help: Write when the register cash was used: change for a customer when the ticket machine broke, paying a supplier on the spot, etc. A refund needs a reason.
book.name: Name (supplier etc.)
book.reasonPlaceholder: Refund reason (required), e.g. the ticket machine gave no change

cash.noPrevious: There is no report from the previous shift, so enter the carried amount.
cash.help: Count the register cash (for change when the ticket machine breaks and for paying suppliers). Ticket-machine sales are not included.

error.badNumber: A number is not valid (whole numbers only).
error.counts: Count the cash and enter the numbers.
error.cashReason: Write the reason for the cash over / short.
error.noodleReason: Write the reason for the noodle difference.
error.required: Enter the tickets and the cash.
error.dateRange: You can record only yesterday’s, today’s or tomorrow’s shifts.

locked: More than 12 hours have passed since it was sent, so only managers can change it.

photo.action: Read from a photo of the daily report
photo.title: Read from a photo of the daily report
photo.help: Photograph the filled daily report (page 1) straight, in good light, with the whole sheet in the picture. The AI reads it and fills in the report below. Nothing is saved yet.
photo.readingHint: This takes about 20 seconds. Please stay on this screen.
photo.readFailed: Could not read it ({{error}}). Take the photo again or type the figures.
photo.checkHelp: Compare with the paper. Fix or check every 🔴. Figures in a yellow box are ones the AI could not read clearly.
photo.allOk: The paper's results and the app's match. Compare with the paper, then send.
photo.savedWith: When you save (draft or send), the photo is saved with the report.
photo.discard: Stop using the photo (what was filled in is cleared)

flag.slot: The photo looks like the report of "{{what}}", not the store / date / shift chosen above.
flag.compare: {{label}}: the paper says {{paper}}, the app computes {{app}}.
flag.carried: Carried over: the paper says {{paper}}, the previous shift's report {{app}} (the app uses the previous shift's amount).
flag.countsMissing: The paper has no count per bill / coin (only the total {{total}}). Count the cash and enter the numbers.
flag.staffTime: {{name}}: paper {{paper}}, shift table {{planned}}. If late / left early / overtime, change the status.
flag.staffNotOnPaper: {{name}} (shift table {{planned}}) is not on the paper. If they were absent, set the status to "Absent".
flag.staffUnknown: Could not find "{{written}}" in the staff list. Check the name.
flag.otherOut: Other noodles out: {{text}} → enter it with "Record noodle waste / damage".
flag.waterHour: Water meter {{hour}}:00 ({{value}}) is not a time of this shift, so it was not filled in.
flag.unsure: {{n}} figure(s) the AI could not read clearly (yellow boxes).
